content.short: Fiat24 lets clients manage fiat and crypto in one dashboard and make transactions using both assets.
content.description: Fiat24 broadens any crypto wallet by adding account and payment features, letting users oversee fiat and crypto balances from a single, easy-to-use interface and transact in either asset with confidence. Clients gain blockchain-native cash accounts and can top up via crypto transfers or bank wires, send or receive funds within the Fiat24 ecosystem, and perform instant currency exchanges, all from one integrated platform that keeps fiat and crypto flows together.
content.meta: Fiat24 adds account and payment services to crypto wallets, unifying fiat and crypto. Discover Fiat24 and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
